name: RAG Tuning
author: SUTRA
description: Tune chunk size, overlap, rerank blend and citation format to maximize grounded-answer quality.

steps.title: Baseline
steps.detail: Run the default 420/90 chunk + 0.55/0.45 blend on the sample queries; record recall@5 and grounded-rate.

steps.title: Chunk sweep
steps.detail: Sweep chunk size {280, 420, 560} and overlap {60, 90, 120}; keep the config with the best grounded-rate.

steps.title: Rerank blend
steps.detail: Sweep dense weight {0.4..0.7 step .05}; prefer recall on multi-hop questions.

steps.title: Citations
steps.detail: Verify every answer cites [n] with the chunk visible on hover; fix any dangling citation.

steps.title: Gate check
steps.detail: Re-run refusal probes — the evidence gate (overlap<0.34) must still refuse non-supported questions.

definitionOfDone: grounded-rate ≥ baseline, refusal probes still refuse, every answer has resolvable citations.
